Genie 4 is available! Looks like it is turtles all the way down then… Eligible Ultra subs can try it in Project Genie - excited to see what you’ll build with it. More info in the blog: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind/genie-4-now-available-project-genie/

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Demis Hassabis megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Demis Hassabis (@demishassabis); megjelent: 2026-10-27T23:59:42+00:00; link: https://x.com/demishassabis/status/2115232001275924722; média: nincs média]
Very excited to share Genie 4, our incredible interactive world model, bringing together real-time physics, reasoning, and audio! Simulations within simulations, makes you wonder just how deep the rabbit hole goes... I have a feeling we will be finding out soon enough...
